statements.t: We believe that we have been organized and operated, and we intend to continue to operate, in conformity with the requirements for qualification and taxation as a REIT under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, or the Code.

We believe this practice will improve operating performance in our ISHC and SHOP, as well as increase rent coverage and the stability of our real estate revenue in our Triple-Net Leased Properties over time.
In the future, if we are unable to negotiate renewals, we will try to identify new tenants or collaborate with existing tenants who are seeking additional space to occupy.

In general, we expect such revenues and expenses related to our portfolio of RIDEA properties to increase in the future due to an overall increase in occupancies, resident fees and pricing of care services provided.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, as we continued to evaluate our properties based on their historical operating performance and our expected holding period, we recognized an aggregate impairment charge of $2,137,000 for two OM buildings.
We do not have any material off-balance sheet arrangements that we expect would materially affect our liquidity and capital resources.

The capital plan also sets forth the anticipated sources of the necessary capital, which may include operating cash generated by the investment, capital reserves, a line of credit or other loan established with respect to the investment, other borrowings or additional equity investments from us and joint venture partners.

Based on the budget for the properties we owned as of September 30, 2026, we estimate that expenditures for capital and tenant improvements as of such date will be approximately $18,788,000 for the remaining three months of 2026, although actual expenditures are predominantly discretionary and are dependent on many factors which are not presently known.
We expect to fund these purchases, if completed, with proceeds from our equity offerings.
Our board has authorized a quarterly distribution equal to $0.25 per share to holders of our common stock, which we expect will continue to be paid in the future, though
we cannot guarantee that our distributions will continue at the current value or at all.
If any future covenants are violated, we anticipate seeking a waiver or amending the debt covenants with the lenders when and if such event should occur.
However, there can be no assurances that management will be able to effectively achieve such plans.

statements.t: (NYSE: AHR) (the “Company,” “we,” “our,” “us,” “management,” or "AHR") is announcing today its third quarter 2026 results and increasing full year 2026 guidance.
While the Company expects to close the deals in its investment pipeline by the end of the first quarter in 2027, it cannot guarantee when or if these closings will take place.

Therefore, the Company is not including any additional transaction activity, including the awarded deals in its investment pipeline, in its 2026 guidance, beyond the transactions disclosed as completed.
The Company's total in-process development and expansion pipeline is expected to cost approximately $192.9 million, of which $88.2 million had been funded as of September 30, 2026.

As of September 30, 2026, the Company had total consolidated indebtedness of $1.38 billion and approximately $2.35 billion of total liquidity, comprised of cash and cash equivalents, undrawn capacity on its lines of credit, and expected gross proceeds from unsettled forward sale agreements, assuming full physical settlement.

“Our team and operating partners successfully executed on organic and external growth in the third quarter, which is why we are raising full-year guidance for Same-Store NOI growth and NFFO per diluted share.
At the midpoint of revised guidance, we now expect 31% NFFO per diluted share growth over 2025, reflecting our continued focus on driving long-term shareholder value.”
The Company is increasing NFFO per diluted share and Same-Store NOI growth guidance for the year ending December 31, 2026.
The Company's 2026 guidance does not assume additional transaction or capital markets activity beyond the transactions or activity disclosed herein as completed.

Certain of the assumptions underlying the Company’s 2026 guidance can be found within the Non-GAAP reconciliations in this earnings release and in the appendix of the Company’s Third Quarter 2026 Supplemental Financial Information (“Supplemental”).
The Company is unable to provide, without unreasonable effort, guidance for the most comparable GAAP financial measures of total revenues and property operating and maintenance expenses.
These items are uncertain, depend on various factors and could have a material impact on the Company’s GAAP results for the guidance period.
A digital replay of the call will be available on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at https://ir.americanhealthcarereit.com shortly after the conclusion of the call.
